{
  "verdict": "fix",
  "issues": [
    "GET /tasks returns an unbounded array; no pagination, filtering, sorting, or maximum limit is defined, creating performance and abuse risk.",
    "PATCH validation is underspecified: behavior for empty body, unknown fields, null values, wrong types, empty or whitespace-only title, and title length is not defined.",
    "Read-only fields (id, createdAt, updatedAt) are not protected; the proposal does not state whether client-supplied values in POST or PATCH are ignored or rejected.",
    "No concurrency control is defined for PATCH or DELETE, so concurrent updates can silently overwrite each other.",
    "Invalid identifier handling is missing: it is unclear whether malformed task IDs return 400 or 404, and UUID path validation is not specified.",
    "Error handling is incomplete: no detailed validation error structure, no codes for malformed JSON, unsupported Content-Type, or oversized payloads, and no mention of the required Allow header for 405 responses.",
    "Operational safeguards are absent: no rate limiting, request body size limits, or abuse mitigation despite public unauthenticated CRUD.",
    "updatedAt semantics are not fully specified: it is unclear whether it changes on a no-op PATCH or only when mutable fields actually change."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add pagination or at least a hard maximum result size for GET /tasks, plus optional filtering and sorting.",
    "Define PATCH contract precisely: require at least one writable field, reject unknown or read-only fields, reject null for required non-nullable fields, validate title after trimming, and return field-level validation errors.",
    "Explicitly mark id, createdAt, and updatedAt as server-generated read-only fields and specify that client-provided values are rejected.",
    "Add optimistic concurrency control using ETag/If-Match or updatedAt-based conditional requests, returning 409 or 412 on conflicts.",
    "Specify that malformed or non-existent task IDs return 404 to avoid leaking validation details or enabling enumeration.",
    "Extend the error model with codes such as VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_JSON, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, and PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, and include field-level details for validation failures.",
    "Add rate limiting, maximum JSON payload size, and basic abuse protection even though authentication is out of scope.",
    "Clarify that updatedAt is updated only when title or completed actually changes and use it as part of resource versioning."
  ]
}
